name: In Service of Zephras
label: Quest
description: In Service of Zephras: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.
Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
